changelog: the performance case on the landing page (#53)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

from pathlib import Path
from lypning import bench, engines, paths, corpus
import subprocess

PYPY = Path("/opt/homebrew/bin/pypy3").resolve()
arms = ["cpython", "lypning", "lypning-l", "mixture", bench.Arm("pypy3", PYPY)]
resolved = bench.resolve_arms(arms)
names = [a.name for a in resolved]
print("resolved arms:", names)
assert "pypy3" in names, "PYPY ARM WAS DROPPED"
for a in resolved:
    print("   %-10s %s" % (a.name, a.binary))
print()
print("project_dir:", paths.project_dir())
print("state_dir:  ", paths.state_dir())
print()
for label, cmd in (("cpython", ["/opt/homebrew/bin/python3","-VV"]), ("pypy3", [str(PYPY),"-VV"])):
    print(label, "->", subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip().replace("\n"," "))
print()
ent = corpus.load_default()
print("corpus loaded:", len(ent), "programs")
print()
su = bench.startup(15, arms)
base = su.get("cpython")
print("startup — -c 'pass', min of 15, arms interleaved")
print("%-12s %10s  %s" % ("arm", "min ms", "vs cpython"))
for n in ["lypning","lypning-l","mixture","cpython","pypy3"]:
    v = su.get(n)
    if v is None:
        print("%-12s %10s  %s" % (n, "—", "(no sample)")); continue
    print("%-12s %10.3f  %.3fx" % (n, v, v/base))
